bug.title: `scholium verify` does not mention a paper's withdrawal: a withdrawn paper reads "No retraction, correction or tombstone applies" and nothing else
bug.symptoms: checklist.py _supersession_item (~L248-266) words only retraction, tombstone and correction (from record-core's supersessions); withdrawal records (record type `withdrawal`, body target/paper/reason or reasonCid) are never read by the CLI. On the verify app's export, sch:dokj-s3m5-3vlz (withdrawn by its author, with a reason) verifies as an ordinary listed paper
bug.reproduction_steps: Withdraw a listed paper through the UI (as one of its authors, with a reason), export the node (/v1/export/archive.car) and run `scholium verify archive.car`
bug.expected: Per D1: for each paper, a withdrawal record whose target is the paper's genesis or one of its versions and which is signed by one of the paper's listed authors adds one WARN line under the paper: "Withdrawn by the authors: " (reason truncated to ~200 characters on one line; "(reason in record )" when only reasonCid is given), followed by "withdrawal signed by (applies)" in the notices detail like the other notices; a withdrawal signed by anyone else is listed in the detail as "(not applied: not signed by an author of this paper)" and adds no line. The "No retraction, correction or tombstone applies" line stays when true. The paper's status, the whole-archive summary counts and the exit code do not change; the summary appends ", 1 withdrawn by its authors" (plural: "N withdrawn by their authors") after the counts when any apply. A single-paper `scholium verify` on a paper file shows the same line. Tests: test_cli_verify_api_export.py (an export with an author-signed withdrawal: the line, the summary suffix, exit 0, status unchanged; an outsider-signed withdrawal: not applied, no line); test_cli_verify_command.py (single paper with a withdrawal)
bug.actual: The archive verification is silent about a signed withdrawal notice
